people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
translations.bsb: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.
